definitions.explanation: Describes movement or action that is frustratingly slow or sluggish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧のろのろ⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The cars are moving slowly due to traffic.

examples.japanese: のろのろ⟦{歩|ある}いていたら→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you walk so slowly, you'll be late.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧のろのろ⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{進|すす}めなかった→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The car in front was going so slowly that I couldn't make any progress.

notes:
のろのろ is a mimetic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) expressing frustratingly slow movement. Unlike ⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧, it always carries a negative connotation — implying that the slowness is annoying or problematic.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- のろのろ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧: slow driving
- のろのろ⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to inch forward (e.g., in traffic)
- のろのろ⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk sluggishly
- のろのろ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dawdle, be sluggish

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧: slowly (neutral — can be positive: "take your time")
- のろのろ: slowly (negative — frustratingly slow)
- ⟦もたもた→もたもた：07515_motamota⟧: slow and clumsy (implies fumbling or incompetence)
- ⟦ぐずぐず→ぐずぐず：05844_guzuguzu⟧: dawdling (implies indecision or procrastination)
- ⟦とろとろ→とろとろ：05257_torotoro⟧: sluggish (gentler; also means thick/gooey for food)
